Multiple Rule Changes Set to Take Effect From August 1

Several rule changes are scheduled to be implemented across India starting August 1. These include new regulations for booking Tatkal railway tickets, which will now utilize a token system to reduce long queues. Additionally, changes are expected in GST rules, with the deferral of new e-Way Bill requirements. The price of LPG cylinders and electricity rates are also subject to change in some regions, potentially impacting household budgets.
